sessions.verification: Checked by hand on 2026-11-03 against the file, its OSF metadata, pynapple's head-direction tutorial (which downloads this file) and the paper's Methods (author manuscript, PMC4376557). File: its SHA-256 is the one OSF publishes for jb2gd. Units: 49, of which 31 have location 'adn' (unit ids 4 to 34) and 18 'thalamus'; the tutorial prints 49 units and selects the same 31 ADn units, a second reader of the same file. Time: head direction every 0.0256 s (39.06 Hz; the paper states 39 Hz) from 8812.4 to 10771.3 s, inside the wake epoch [8812.3, 10771.3) s, which lasts 32.6 minutes (the paper: 30 to 45 minutes of foraging); sleep before and after, 2.4 h and 3.1 h (the paper: sleep sessions of about 2 hours, so these run longer); spikes from 0.0015 to 22025.0 s, inside the epochs; 49 gaps longer than 1 s, the longest 8.55 s. Heading: ry from 0 to 2π rad; the frame is stated nowhere read. The file holds no x/y position.
